purpose: Mechanism E exploratory test: SAME_CATEGORY_ENTITY_ENUMERATION, targeting HARMFUL_SIBLING_DISTRACTION (Ledger Entry C).
excludes_note: all 33 units used anywhere in this arena to date (original 10 + Stage2's 10 + RAW_PROVENANCE's 8 + Mechanism D's 5, including the dropped/incomplete 08e075c7). _abs variants also excluded.

inputs_never_used: which units happen to mention multiple same-category entities
selection_rule.method: deterministic category quota (3 multi-session, 2 temporal-reasoning, 1 single-session-user, 1 single-session-assistant, 1 knowledge-update -- 8 total), first-by-question_id-sort within category after exclusion. Weighted toward multi-session/temporal-reasoning (richer, longer conversation histories -> more opportunities for repeated entity mentions across many sessions) -- a category-structure-based prior, not a content-based one, matching the same discipline as prior selections in this campaign.
selection_rule.size_note: 8 units (matching RAW_PROVENANCE's proven exploratory-to-replication-sized sample) rather than a smaller 5-unit sample, given Mechanism D's lesson that a too-small sample risks a regime-mismatch null before the target precondition (here: 2+ same-category entities actually co-occurring in one unit's retrieval) is ever observed even once.
